settings.title: Settings
settings.capture_date_help: Always kept when it exists in the photo, with its time zone and rotation.
settings.camera_details_help: Make, model, lens, and exposure settings.
settings.gps_location_help: Coordinates and altitude, when present. Google Photos downloads never include them.
settings.json_sidecar_help: Create a readable metadata file next to each image.
home.title: Bring your photos and videos home with their dates.
home.intro: Choose photos and videos in Google Photos. We keep the capture date of each file and package the copies in a ZIP for your computer.
google.title: Export your library
google.copy: Sign in, select the photos and videos you want, then download them together. The ZIP keeps each available capture date when extracted.
google.sign_in_tooltip: Connect your Google account. Your sign-in stays on this device.
google.picker_tooltip: Open Google’s picker after signing in.
google.keep_open: Keep this page open until it finishes.
oauth.not_configured: Google sign-in isn’t configured on this copy.
oauth.step_client_html: Create an OAuth client (type Desktop app) under {credentials_link}.
oauth.step_json_html: Download the JSON file and save it as credentials/client_secrets.json (or set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS to its full path).
local.summary_copy: Restore file dates from EXIF on this device
local.title: Restore dates on downloaded photos
local.copy: If a photo still contains its capture date in EXIF, create a copy whose file date matches it. Missing dates cannot be recovered; originals stay untouched.
local.files_tooltip: Choose one or more individual photos.
local.folder_tooltip: Choose every supported photo inside one folder.
local.picker_tooltip: Select photos to process. Nothing is uploaded outside this device.
local.formats: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, HEIC and more
local.submit_tooltip: Create copies using the capture date already stored in EXIF, then download them from the results page.
home.note: Capture dates can only be preserved when they exist in the source photo. Extract the ZIP to retain the date as the file modification time.
job.title: Your files are ready.
job.summary: Download one archive to keep each photo and video’s original date when you extract the files.

job.failed.one: {count} item couldn’t be saved. The rest are ready below.
job.failed.other: {count} items couldn’t be saved. The rest are ready below.

job.zip_hint: Your browser saves the ZIP to Downloads by default. Extract it to preserve each file’s capture date as its modification date; change the download folder in your browser settings if needed.
job.files_hint: Individual downloads are available below. Use the ZIP above when file dates matter.
job.json_details: JSON detail files ({count}) — tap to expand
job.empty: No files found in this folder.

flash.photos_permission_missing: Hic Pic Nunc needs access to Google Photos. Sign in again and tick the Google Photos permission.
flash.signed_in: You're signed in. You can choose photos from Google below.
flash.no_file: No file was uploaded. Try again.
flash.no_supported_images: Choose at least one supported image (JPEG, PNG, etc.).
